headline: Ex-MP Momtaz gets bail in three cases but remains in jail
summary: The High Court granted bail to the former lawmaker and singer in cases linked to the July Uprising, but she faces seven cases in total.
details: The High Court has granted bail to former Awami League MP and folk singer Momtaz Begum in three cases linked to the July Uprising.

caption:
Bail granted, but no release. Former MP and singer Momtaz remains in prison despite a High Court order.

The High Court has granted bail to former Awami League MP and folk singer Momtaz Begum in three cases linked to the July Uprising.

A bench of Justice KM Zahid Sarwar and Justice Sheikh Abu Taher issued the order on Monday.

Despite the bail, Momtaz will not be released immediately as she is facing a total of seven cases.

The cases for which bail was granted include two from Manikganj and one from Kotwali Police Station.

Momtaz was arrested in Dhaka's Dhanmondi on the night of May 12 last year.

She was interrogated in police custody for four days and has remained in jail since then.

A popular folk singer, Momtaz first became an Awami League-backed reserved women’s seat MP in 2008.

She later served as a lawmaker from the Manikganj-2 constituency in 2014 and 2018, but lost her seat in the 2024 general election.

Source: bdnews24.com, Dhaka Tribune
